Action
Ms. Smith (for herself, Mr. Welch, Mr. Booker, Mr. Luján, Mrs. Shaheen, and Mr. Van Hollen) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources
Bill Number
S. 4615
Bill Version
Introduced in Senate
(IS)
Short Title
American Energy Efficiency Act of 2024
Full Title
To amend title VI of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978 to establish a Federal energy efficiency resource standard for electricity and natural gas suppliers, and for other purposes.
